# Named Import service lookup keeps generic-object creation checks

Import::Service selects the registered import service. Outlook mail/address-book branches still check the separate generic-object creation result, set its data and transfer an owning interface through the output. The service delegates to the generic factory after validating the output pointer. Service lookup cleanup does not establish that the requested import object was created or that an import completed. No import runtime was run.

Scope: Mail import component factories.
